verdict.rationale: Self-hosting docs claim a single self-contained binary with local graph engine, local embeddings, and local LLM ('data never leaves the building'), and it boots with no Docker/DB/config — directly supporting local-only, no-cloud-dependency deployment. However this describes running a local server binary, not an embedded in-process library, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation that self-hosted mode truly has zero cloud calls; self-hosting is also listed as a plan/pricing-gated feature (SOC2/HIPAA/self-hosted option), suggesting it may not be a freely embeddable default. Missing for 10: independent verification of fully local operation, evidence of true in-process/embedded (non-server) usage, and confirmation self-hosting isn't restricted to paid tiers.
